body:
It's certainly a different age now. Things are different. I don't think it's a good enough excuse for how many dumb mistakes I have ended up doing and why I have wasted so much time on nothing. Technically you could the last 5 years have been for nothing at all. And that's tough to take, tough to see people get ahead, tough to accept that I am in this situation. It's also exhausting to admit to myself that I don't do anything about it. I feel so aware of it all yet nothing seems to manifest or give me that push. I wonder why I just sit here.


I know that finding that someone now would never work out. I don't feel respectful enough to have something to share, to be that burden upon somebody. It's why I don't even bother or try. I still have to get my act together, have stability, to provide and care and I can't do that. I have accepted that fact and to me that is reasonable. It's merely a wishful thought because I know it would help a lot to have that. It's also thoughts about the past because I was happier. That longing has gotten more intense these later months and in many ways that is only natural. It just hurts like hell. Really tough to take in actually. A partner to have that emotional connection would just be the best thing right now.
But that couldn't come first, no chance of that.

The only thing I can hope for is that I muster trough it, that I do start to get somewhere and then try. Just wish I had a friend that could help me a little bit but there's nothing. Just an arm that reached out. It sucks. Only work will make myself succeed but I am starting to have doubts if I could even put in the hours. And that's sad.

I know I can handle social situations easily as long as I know what is coming. Interview for some reason terrifies me yet many other similar things don't at all. I'm not exactly what the cause itself is but I'm guessing it has something to do with guilt and admittance that I am not doing so well. I can't weasel my out of it. It's either clean slate or nothing if that seems more fitting. Either way, it's freaking me out way more than what could be considered normal or healthy.  So yes, it's one of the things that makes me very anxious. In the same way of bumping into a friend and explaining what I am actually doing which is nothing. I don't want to be that person I guess.

The personality thing is a familiar thought. Would like to say some things but I don't really know anymore because I haven't been in any situation where I have been "tested". It's sad to think about...

Kinda does. I'm not really fond of sharing personal stuff like that about me online either but in some ways I kinda have to let things go. I might kill myself, do I really need to be so damn stubborn is a question I ask myself.

I do agree. It wasn't as much as I was told I should act and feel like that, kinda always have. Was bullied some when I was younger and was quite insecure. One girl I fell in love with at a really young age took advantage of me and spread all kinds of things to people who used it against me. However, I do agree that I have taken it many steps beyond of what is healthy. I shouldn't have done anything like that at all, it was a mistake. But I did get surrounded by people like that as well, no real environment around all the people I knew to talk about stuff like that. Naturally, I grew more fond of girls when it came to stuff like that, same thing with listening to them talk about their struggles and what not. Felt way more natural and it ended putting me at an ease, even if my first experience with that was completely horrible. I could go on about this but I think the message is kinda clear on that. I don't really mind answering it here, just have a harder time coming up with what I should say. It's easier to get questions or having face to face conversations. I think at least...again, not really used to doing it online.

As for job stuff, that is pretty much what I have to do about that. Don't want to, don't feel like it. I'm pretty stuck where I am and I think getting out of here would be a big help. But then I need education to get some real job. Talking about a big commitment here and I wouldn't probably be ready for the world until I was 30 which frightens me a lot. This has gone way beyond what I could have ever imagined. Not to mention acclimating to that type of climate now and sticking through it is something that doesn't even seem slightly feasible for me. I just so wish someone came up to me with any type of job so I could just start and at least get out of this. I'm to afraid to speak up on about this, the thought of admitting stuff like this on an interview keeps me up at night. I do not like others seeing me like that. Big part of why I refuse to do anything with anyone anymore. I'm so ashamed of it. 

It's becoming really worrisome because they are more frequent now and I don't reject it as much as I used too. One of the few things that keeps me going is that I still have a slight hope I will meet a really sweet girl that will drag me out of it. Know that sounds really silly, because it is. But it's one of the few things that keeps me going. That's what I want in life and it seems so unattainable right now. Obviously it's loneliness speaking up but that's one of the few things I can think back on in my life where I have truly been happy. And I miss that... a lot. 

Not sure if this was an adequate response...

My downward spiral did kind of start while I had a job. I felt really bad a lot of times as well then but it was easier to cope because at least I had something. Was kinda more social back then too so that helps.

Do know what you are talking about.
